markets.rules_primary: If Jeremiyah Love records the most Rushing Yards among all players in the game for the Arizona vs New York G Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 4, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
If Jeremiyah Love does not participate in the game the market will resolve to No. If multiple players tie for the most yards, the markets will resolve to 1/N, where N is the number of players tied for the highest value. No holders will receive $1 minus the Yes payout.
